about_the_game:
More than a deck builder

In Leavers Rift, you don't just play cards. You travel through a world that is undergoing change, guided by the stories of heroes and companions. Learn what it means to love. Discover new life forms. Examine fossils. Explore your newly awakened feelings that surpass every echo. Study the influences of the mother and the stranger.

You can find more information on the main game page.

Demo contains:

  • First hero: The Legionnaire - with all his relics and cards

  • ALL current relics, events, neutral cards

  • The entire first chapter

  • All 3 regions with all enemies

What is not included?

  • Heroes: Jinni and Sun Mantis

  • Chapter 2 and 3

  • Achievements / Unlockables

  • Everything that's planned to be added to the main game during Early Access, like:

    • Hero Soul Marionette

    • Chapters 4-10

    • new enemies and bosses

    • Region 4

    • new relics, events, neutral cards

    • more Achievements

How many hours does the demo offer?

Well, it’s still a roguelike, so… infinite?

Jokes aside: A full run with the Legionnaire through chapter 1 takes about 3 hours - assuming you make it on your first try.

The demo will be permanently available for the time being.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB / Intel Arc A380 6 GB
  • Storage: 13 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti 8 GB / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT 16 GB
  • Storage: 13 GB available space

short_description: Explore the surreal world surrounding the Leavers Rift in this immersive roguelike deckbuilder. Build powerful decks, collect treasures, and lose yourself in a dramatic story about humanity in a realm of magic. Uncover the influence of foreign forces and save your world!
